faq.a: It is a primary official Netflix account divided into individual profiles. You will be assigned one exclusive profile that only you will use with your own PIN lock.

faq.q: What is the difference between the Standard and Premium plans?
faq.a: The Standard Plan offers Full HD (1080p) video quality, which is ideal for mobiles, tablets and regular screens. The Premium Plan offers Ultra HD (4K) + HDR quality for the ultimate visual experience on 4K TVs and high-res displays.

faq.q: What is your Refund & Return Policy, and can I test before final activation?
faq.a: Yes! To ensure complete satisfaction and transparency, we first provide a test account for you to check the streaming quality and service. Once you test it and confirm everything is working smoothly, we will create a brand new custom profile under your name with your own security PIN. If the test account experiences any unresolved technical issue on our end before setup, a full refund will be provided.

faq.q: Can I watch on my mobile and TV at the same time?
faq.a: No, a 1-screen package allows streaming on only 1 device at a time. If you want to switch devices, simply pause or log out from the previous device.

faq.q: Can I change the account email or password?
faq.a: Absolutely not. Changing the primary email or master password is strictly prohibited and will result in a permanent account block and voided warranty.

faq.q: What happens if the profile stops working or gets locked later?
faq.a: We provide full customer support throughout your subscription period. If any technical issue arises, we will quickly resolve it or provide an immediate replacement profile.
